verdict.rationale: Attio Workflows is documented as a visual automation builder where workspace members define sequences of automated action blocks. Event triggers such as "When a new deal is created" fire agent steps like enrichment, scoring and routing. The App SDK adds custom triggers and steps that subscribe to external events, webhooks cover real-time change events, and users can ask Attio AI to build workflows from a plain-language goal. Missing for 10: documentation of the full trigger catalog and of conditional rule logic (filters/branching inside workflows), plus independent or hands-on corroboration.
